$doc: The worked checks-config for a two-plane desktop app (a purchasing-ops domain; plan app-templates-2026-07-04 P-007/P-013). Schema: @papercusp/template-kit TemplateChecksConfig. A materialized app copies the portable check files verbatim and writes ITS OWN config shaped like this one (app.root='.' means 'place beside the app repo root'; run via a `template-checks` npm script at the app root). boot.mode is 'attach' because the app-home operator.json is a per-user singleton — use 'spawn' with a command only on a machine where the app is NOT live. Pinned by template-kit's checks-config tests.

components.$doc: P-022 (agentic-desktop-app re-layered onto the desktop-app base): the composition's npm-visible component pins. PATTERN components map to app-local packages (embedded-postgres-server -> @purchase-ops/embedded-postgres-server; typed-contracts -> @purchase-ops/contracts); papergrid is a META-package so the app depends on the SUB-package it uses (@papercusp/grid-core); lexicon is DROPPED per the ui template's ui-surfaces decision point (see DECISIONS.md).
